candidates.reason: Genuine 2024 colour photo categorised to Chatham Islands, but it is a posed group of ~15 people on the deck steps of a plain modern building. People are the subject, the marae is not recognisable (no carved house, entrance or setting), and it is a flat snapshot. Fails 'no people as subject' and shows_named_thing.

current.reason: Sepia 1910 archive portrait (Canterbury Museum, Category Old photos) of five Moriori people; people are the subject, not the marae; archival, fails pre-filter.
